sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

Breaking change

The `/v2/users` endpoint no longer returns a `name` field. The endpoint returns `first_name` and `last_name` fields. Clients that read `name` fail after the upgrade. This release keeps the rest of the `/v2/users` response shape the same.

Migration

If your client reads the `name` field, change the client to read `first_name` and `last_name`. Map the two fields in your code before you send the response to users.

New flag

The `--incremental` flag is available for export and sync commands. The flag processes only new and changed rows. When you omit the flag, full runs still work.

Performance

Parquet writes complete 40% faster than in the previous release. Large exports finish in less time because the write path uses less CPU.
